question: ________________, established in 1829, is the oldest golf club in India and the first outside Great Britain.
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Royal Calcutta Golf Club.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Royal Calcutta Golf Club was established in 1829, making it the oldest golf club in India.**
 
• **It is also the first golf club established outside of Great Britain.**
 
• The club is located **in Kolkata** and has a rich history, having hosted several prestigious golf tournaments.
 
• **Some of the notable members of the club include famous Indian cricketer Sourav Ganguly and former Indian President Pranab Mukherjee.**

** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **East Point Golf Club: This golf club is located in Visakhapatnam and was established in 1884.**

 
 
• It ​is the only golf course that is open to people from all walks of life.
 
• EPGC, as it is commonly referred to, is an independent, non-profit entity that focuses on providing services aimed at enhancing the game of Golf, and the skill levels of its members who have a desire to improve the standard of their game through the organization of training programmes and competitions.
 
 
 
• **The Bangalore Golf Club: This golf club is also located in Bangalore and was established in 1876. It was initially a 12-hole Golf Course.**
 
 
• For decades since its founding, it was used by the Army as a training ground.
 
• In 2002, the entire landscape was wholly restructured to give birth to an **18-hole golf course** of international standard.
 
 
 
• **​Cosmopolitan Club: This is not a golf club but a social club located in Chennai.**
 
 
• It was founded in **1873**.
 
• Renowned for its fine cuisine, superb sports facilities, and residential accommodation, Cosmopolitan Club has kept pace with the changing times.
